title: 第52章 上戏毕业班领头羊

第52章 上戏毕业班领头羊-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

“尊敬的各位领导、老师，亲爱的同学们，大家好。我是上戏2004级毕业生魏沐。今天，能够作为毕业生代表站在这里发言，我感到无比荣幸......”

上戏剧院，近两个月大出风头的魏沐，强势拿下优秀毕业生代表，上台致辞。

台下，时任04级表演班班主任的谷一安笑得合不拢嘴。

哎呀，天道有轮回，好运到我家。

他怎么也没想到，短短三个月时间，魏沐竟成为上戏乃至全中国表演院校最出风头的学生。

天上掉下来一块大饼，砸的他晕头转向。

上戏每一届表演班班主任，都是压力最大的一个人。

怎么评价你带的好？

当然看成绩说话。

不同于其他院校看考试成绩，他们表演院校是看成材率。

说白了，就是要出明星！！

上戏00级，有郭京飞、万茜。

上戏01级，有胡哥、韩鳕。

上戏02级目前还没看出有哪些出名的。

本来，他不指望上戏04级，毕竟大家都是学生，需要发展时间。

没想到蹦出来个魏沐！！

演讲结束，魏沐没有马上下来，而是被上戏副院长韩生叫过去谈话。

看着被上戏副院长勉励一番的同班同学，整个04级表演班心情复杂。

陈贺杜姜郑凯三人组与有荣焉，好歹是一个宿舍出来的。

舍友过得好，能忘得了他们？

书上都说，苟富贵勿相忘。

“老魏，牛逼！！”

从台上下来，魏沐回到位子上，旁边座位的陈贺低声喊一嗓子。

杜姜和郑凯纷纷竖起大拇指。

老郑还不忘看一眼坐在后排的王传军，后者表情跟吃了屎一样难受。

老话说得好，自己的失败固然可怕，但朋友的成功更让人揪心。

关键，他和魏沐还是情敌！！

对方的成功和上次他讲的那番话形成鲜明对比。

王传军感觉自己就像个小丑，只想赶紧领完毕业证书跑路，再也不回学校。

嗯....魏沐和他的想法一样，也想跑路。

刚才勉励他的副院长来到台前，开始长篇大论。

这是领导的被动技能，空话套话章口就来，两个小时不带重样。

要不是有优秀毕业生这个身份，他现在已经溜号。

无聊的翻看手机，清一清垃圾短信。

成名以后的烦恼，手机收到各种垃圾短信。

大部分是粉丝，还有少部分黑粉。

可惜现在没有微博，否则后台就能收到女菩萨的短信。

那些人很纯粹，只想进入他的身体，不想打扰他的生活。

Chapter 52 The leader of the graduating class of Shanghai Opera - "China Entertainment 2008: Starting from a happy breakup"

Previous chapter

Save bookmarks

Next chapter

"Dear leaders, teachers, dear classmates, hello everyone. I am Wei Mu, a 2004 graduate of Shanghai Opera. Today, I feel extremely honored to be able to stand here and speak as a representative of the graduates..."

Wei Mu, who has been in the limelight for the past two months in the theater, won the outstanding graduate representative and went on stage to deliver a speech.

In the audience, Gu Yian, then the head teacher of the 04-level performance class, smiled from ear to ear.

Oh, God has reincarnation, good luck comes to my family.

He never expected that in just three months, Wei Mu would become the most popular student in the theater and even in all Chinese acting schools.

A piece of cake fell from the sky and hit him dizzy.

The head teacher of every acting class is the person who faces the most pressure.

How would you rate your performance?

Of course it depends on the results.

Unlike other schools that look at test scores, their performance school looks at success rates.

To put it bluntly, we want to produce stars!!

In the 00-level drama, there are Guo Jingfei and Wan Qian.

On level 01, there are Hu Ge and Han Ha.

I haven’t seen any famous ones in level 02 of the drama.

Originally, he did not expect to go to the 04th level of drama. After all, everyone is a student and needs development time.

Unexpectedly, Wei Mu popped out!!

After the speech, Wei Mu did not come down immediately. Instead, he was called over by Han Sheng, the deputy director of Shanghai Theater Academy, for a talk.

Seeing the classmates being encouraged by the deputy director of the theater, the entire 04-level acting class had mixed emotions.

The trio of Chen He, Du Jiang, Zheng Kai and Yourong Yan all came from the same dormitory.

The roommates are doing well, can they be forgotten?

It is said in books that no matter how rich or noble you are, don’t forget each other.

"Old Wei, awesome!!"

After getting off the stage, Wei Mu returned to his seat, and Chen He, who was sitting next to him, shouted in a low voice.

Du Jiang and Zheng Kai gave thumbs up.

Lao Zheng did not forget to take a look at Wang Chuanjun, who was sitting in the back row. The latter looked as if he had eaten shit.

As the old saying goes, your own failure is terrible, but your friend's success is even more heart-wrenching.

The key is, he and Wei Mu are still love rivals!!

The other party's success was in sharp contrast to what he said last time.

Wang Chuanjun felt like a clown. He just wanted to get his diploma and run away, never to return to school.

Hmm... Wei Mu had the same idea as him and wanted to run away.

The vice-dean who had just encouraged him came to the stage and started a long speech.

This is a leader's passive skill. You can just talk and talk nonsense without repeating it for two hours.

If it weren't for his status as an outstanding graduate, he would have left the company by now.

I scrolled through my phone boredly, clearing out junk text messages.

The trouble after becoming famous is that I receive all kinds of spam text messages on my phone.

Most of them are fans, and a few are anti-fans.

It's a pity that there is no Weibo now, otherwise I would receive text messages from the female Bodhisattva in the background.

Those people were very pure, they just wanted to enter his body and didn't want to disturb his life.
